title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open Hybrid Mamba-Attention MoE
hook: NVIDIA's open 550B model interleaves Mamba and attention inside a Mixture-of-Experts - hitting ~6x the inference throughput of comparable LLMs at on-par accuracy.
key_points: 550B total parameters with only 55B active per token (Mixture-of-Experts), mixing Mamba state-space layers with attention.
Reports ~6x higher inference throughput than state-of-the-art public LLMs at on-par accuracy, with a 1M-token context.
Pretrained on 20T tokens, then post-trained with SFT, RL, and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD).
Recipe stacks LatentMoE, Multi-Token Prediction, NVFP4 low-precision pretraining, and reasoning-budget control.
Fully open: base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints plus the training data and recipe.
content_html: Nemotron 3 Ultra is NVIDIA's most capable open model to date: a 550-billion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts with 55 billion active parameters, built as a hybrid of Mamba state-space layers and attention. By leaning on linear-time Mamba mixing for most of the sequence work and reserving attention where it matters, NVIDIA reports up to ~6x higher inference throughput than state-of-the-art public LLMs at on-par accuracy — with a context window extended to 1M tokens, useful for long-running agentic tasks.
extra_html: It was pretrained on 20 trillion text tokens, then post-trained with supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). The recipe combines several techniques NVIDIA highlights — LatentMoE, Multi-Token Prediction (MTP), NVFP4 low-precision pretraining, multi-environment RLVR, and reasoning-budget control. Notably, the base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints ship openly on Hugging Face alongside the training data and recipe. Throughput and accuracy figures are NVIDIA's own; see the technical report for benchmark details.

related.title: Mamba: Linear-Time Sequence Modeling with Selective State Spaces
related.hook: Make the state-space transitions depend on the input itself, add a hardware-aware scan, and you get a linear-time sequence model that matches Transformers on language - with no KV cache.

related.title: What Is a Mixture of Experts?
related.hook: Instead of running every input through one big network, route each token to a few specialist sub-networks - total capacity grows without proportional compute.

related.title: Subquadratic Architectures: xLSTM vs. Mamba-2 vs. Gated DeltaNet
related.hook: Transformers pay a quadratic tax on sequence length. Pitting xLSTM, Mamba-2, and Gated DeltaNet head-to-head on hard tasks, xLSTM comes out ahead — and the paper explains why.

flashcards.prompt: What two sequence-mixing mechanisms does Nemotron 3 Ultra combine, and what's the payoff?
flashcards.back_html: Mamba (state-space) layers for cheap linear-time mixing plus attention layers. The hybrid reports ~6x higher inference throughput than comparable public LLMs at on-par accuracy, with a 1M-token context.

flashcards.prompt: Nemotron 3 Ultra has 550B total parameters. How many are active per token?

choices.text: 55B — it's a Mixture-of-Experts, so only a subset of experts fire per token

flashcards.explanation_html: As a Mixture-of-Experts, Nemotron 3 Ultra routes each token to a small subset of experts: 55B active out of 550B total parameters.

flashcards.prompt: Beyond SFT and RL, what post-training step does Nemotron 3 Ultra add?
flashcards.back_html: Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) — the model is trained on its own outputs with supervision from multiple teacher models — alongside SFT and RL.
